labels: My thought: there is growth worth appreciating.
So I give the six shoots the strongest drawn frames.
The four bare pots stay visible. Appreciation does not erase them.
optimism.alt: Six growing pots are enclosed by ornate green and gold medallions in a garden-journal composition; four bare pots remain visible on the right.

labels: Four gaps take over the page.
An inspection sheet focused on missing growth
But this view gives them less emphasis.
My thought: the missing growth dominates my view.
So I build a heavier frame around the four bare pots.
Nothing has become worse. The emphasis has changed.
pessimism.alt: A heavy rust-colored inspection block, arrows and brackets emphasize four bare pots on the right; six growing pots remain visible on the left.

labels: Before judging, look at all ten.
A field notebook for observation and questions
SAME FACTS  /  EQUAL ATTENTION, OPEN QUESTIONS
curiosity.alt: A blue field-notebook grid gives all ten pots equal space, numbers and observation labels, with questions about expectations and causes.
